description: A verbatim 2-NAND + 1-LATCH fragment of full.json: the final TTMn-to-jump output stage for the LEFT hemisphere. In full.json this is the pair of NAND inverters that convert the left TTMn threshold unit's single-bit firing decision (and the shared reset pin) into active-low set/reset pulses, feeding the 'jump_left' LATCH that holds the fly's jump-commanded state. It is a real sub-piece of the real circuit -- the gate ids, gate types, and wiring below are copied unchanged from full.json (see test_seed_fragment.py), just with the two upstream signals (the left TTMn firing decision and the reset pin) re-exposed as this fragment's own named input pins instead of being computed by the (here, omitted) upstream adder-tree/comparator logic.
